match_name: Gujarat Titans v RCB at Ahmedabad, Tata Indian Premier League, 30 Apr 2026

commentary: A length ball drifting wide outside off from the leg spinner, driven into a sharp cut shot. Rahul Tewatia carves it with controlled precision, racing the ball away for a well-taken two. That moves Gujarat Titans along to 151 for 6.
match_name: Gujarat Titans v RCB at Ahmedabad, Tata Indian Premier League, 30 Apr 2026

commentary: A back of a length leg spinner pitched on off stump, pulled with precision by Rahul Tewatia for a quick single to deep square leg.
match_name: Gujarat Titans v RCB at Ahmedabad, Tata Indian Premier League, 30 Apr 2026

commentary: Rashid Khan reads the googly well and executes a neat, low sweep through the leg side, picking up two runs comfortably.
match_name: Gujarat Titans v RCB at Ahmedabad, Tata Indian Premier League, 30 Apr 2026

commentary: Rashid Khan picks it up nicely, driving that short ball outside off with precision and timing. The controlled stroke races through extra cover for a crisp boundary. Gujarat Titans reach the target! Gujarat Titans win by 4 wickets!
match_name: Gujarat Titans v RCB at Ahmedabad, Tata Indian Premier League, 30 Apr 2026
